title: Public form thank-you text cannot name the record it created: no template slot, and the submit answer carries the id only
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaJoinvGQSbHeDaWBe

Filing gate: ③ triage-directed. The order on #27398 (rows 2–3) said: take what is ui-only, card the rest. The card thread read the code on current `main` (report 6517203519, `out_of_scope_findings`). Row 2 is taken in PR #28003.
Reach: web-to-case and any public form whose visitor needs a reference (a case number) after submit (#27398 row 3).
Reader who acts: `domain:spec` first, because it needs a contract decision before any code. Then a `domain:server` card for the submit answer, blocked by it, then ui interpolation.
Duplicate search: `search_issues` "form submitBehavior thank-you message translation or record number interpolation public form" → no open card.

## Observed
- The confirmation panel shows the authored `title` and `message` verbatim (`ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`).
- The spec's thank-you member (`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`) declares them as plain strings with no template slot. The `redirect` member already interpolates declared record fields as `{{record.FIELD}}`.
- `POST /api/v1/forms/SLUG/submit` answers `{ id }` only, on purpose. Its comment (`packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts`) says the stored row can carry values an elevated `beforeInsert` / `afterInsert` hook derived from records the anonymous form grant may never read, so the answer echoes nothing the insert stored.

## Decision needed (triage routes it)
- **A:** the thank-you text may name declared fields, and the answer carries exactly the fields the text names. This accepts that trade-off for author-named fields.
- **B:** the slot admits only engine-generated fields (autonumber), and the answer carries only those.
- **C:** will not do; keep the id-only answer.

A or B is a template slot (contract review owed) plus a served answer field (`Metadata-protocol` added).

Dedupe words: thank-you record number, public form submit answer id only, submitBehavior interpolate record, case number thank-you.

Related: #27398 (row 3).
